title: Petition of Essex County Gas Company requesting that the Department of Public Utilities allow the Company to defer certain unrecovered expenditures that have been incurred associated with the Company's compliance with the requirements of G.L. c. 21E, relating to the disposal of gas meters.
petitioner: Essex Gas Company D/B/A National Grid
filings: Letter to Robert J. Keegan, Keohane & Keegan, re. a petition to defer certain expenditures. Accordingly the petition is dismissed By: Commissioners: Gordon, Kates-Garnick and Webster. (91-102).
